Fixed annual rate, monthly compounding. Excludes fees, insurance and taxes.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the loan amount (principal).
  2. Enter the annual interest rate percentage.
  3. Enter the tenure and choose years or months.
  4. Your monthly EMI, total interest and total payable appear instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the EMI formula?

EMI = P x r x (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where P is the loan amount, r is the monthly interest rate and n is the number of months.

Does this include fees or taxes?

No. This calculates EMI from principal and interest only; processing fees, insurance and taxes are not included.

What if the interest rate is 0%?

With 0% interest the EMI is simply the loan amount divided by the number of months.
